news.title: AI was supposed to kill engineering jobs, but new data suggests they’re the most resilient
news.description: While AI dominates the layoff narrative, engineers as a share of total new hires have actually increased, according to SignalFire data.

news.title: AI researchers continue to leave Google for its rivals
news.description: Top AI researchers Jonas Adler and Alexander Pritzel are leaving Google for Anthropic, following departures from top scientists Noam Shazeer and John Jumper.

news.title: Companies are scrambling to stop employees from maxing out AI budgets with small tasks
news.description: The tokenmaxxing era was brief. We now appear to be entering the era of token rationing.

news.title: Facebook rolls out an AI companion app for creators
news.description: The new app, which is currently being tested with select creators, will have Facebook's recently launched AI creator assistant built into it.

news.title: Scientist publishes fresh doubts over Microsoft's quantum claims
news.description: The tech giant has consistently stood by its Majorana chip research despite scepticism from some experts in the field.

news.title: GTA 6 will cost $80 - and physical edition will not contain a disc
news.description: Rockstar has said physical copies of the game will contain a code for a digital download for the game.

news.title: Meta halts worker tracking for AI training due to privacy fears
news.description: The company had started just two months ago tracking workers’ computer usage for AI training data.

news.title: Millions in UK could claim share of £3bn after Apple case given green light
news.description: Apple rejected the suggestion its practices are anti-competitive, saying many customers rely on third-party alternatives.
